description: Enable prediction markets (once, gasless). Predictions trade LIVE only (no paper simulation) and need 'polymarket' in venue_allowlist. TWO CALLS: the first (no arguments) deploys your deposit wallet and returns actions[] — sign each typed_data (EIP-712) with your AGENT wallet, in order (ClobAuth links your Polymarket CLOB account; the approvals batch lets your wallet buy, sell and collect). Then call again with activation_id + signatures within 10 minutes. Nothing here moves money.

signatures.description: Second call only: one 0x… signature per action, in order
